title: ros2_control overview
keywords: ros2_control controller_manager controller controllers hardware interface interfaces command state claimed urdf update_rate
text: ros2_control connects controllers to hardware. The controller_manager runs a real-time loop at update_rate (100 Hz by default): it reads hardware states, updates every active controller and writes commands. Hardware components, described in the robot URDF's ros2_control tag, export command interfaces (for example a joint velocity) and state interfaces (position, velocity). A command interface can be claimed by only one active controller at a time, so activating a second controller that needs it fails. Joint or interface names that differ between the URDF and the controller YAML are a common reason a controller does not load.
